decision: held: abstract of 24229674 gives no capsule amount; its full text is needed to tell whether it meets the review's standard for labels printing 40 mg and 150 mg
summary: The stored trial is the only oral controlled trial read with named primary outcomes: enteric-coated capsules added to standard stroke treatment for a year lowered total vascular events, 2.08% vs 6.78% (24229674). Its abstract gives no amount and states no blinding or placebo. An uncontrolled pilot of 10 reported better myocardial perfusion (19416019). A 35-trial meta-analysis in acute stroke reports better Barthel and NIHSS scores (40933244), but its abstract states no route or dose. The LUCENT placebo trial is a protocol only (35410433); no result was found.

population.description: 310 hospitalized patients with ischemic stroke, 192 on lumbrokinase and 118 controls.

study_contexts.study_design: Multicenter randomized parallel-group controlled trial, standard stroke treatment with or without enteric-coated lumbrokinase capsules, 12 months

outcomes.name: Total vascular end points, 2.08% vs 6.78%, P<0.05
Plasma fibrinogen, carotid IMT, vulnerable plaques and carotid plaque volume favored treatment

limitations: The abstract gives no capsule amount or frequency, so the labels' 40 mg and 150 mg can't be compared with it.
Abstract doesn't state blinding or a placebo; the control is standard treatment alone. Arm sizes are unequal.
Primary outcomes are listed as a set; the abstract reports totals, not each one.
Abstract as read on PubMed; full text not read.

read_not_used.40933244: Meta-analysis of 35 RCTs in acute ischemic stroke with supportive care; primary outcomes Barthel Index and NIHSS improved. The abstract doesn't state route or dose, so it isn't entered as oral. Authors urge cautious use.
read_not_used.11321442: Single-blind randomized trial in cerebral infarction, 31 vs 20; abstract states no route, dose or primary outcome.
read_not_used.29093246: 60 pulmonary embolism patients described as retrospectively analyzed and as randomly divided; lumbrokinase with heparin and warfarin; no route, dose or primary outcome in the abstract.
read_not_used.27011386: Safety crossover of DLBS1033 490 mg three times daily in 20 healthy adults; no efficacy outcome.
read_not_used.35410433: Protocol for lumbrokinase plus aspirin vs placebo plus aspirin in acute stroke; no results.

stop_or_hold: 24229674: full text needed for the capsule amount. pm.py prints no PMC id, so full text was not tried.
